title: Canonical p-adic quantum-connection splitting for closed monotone symplectic manifolds without p-torsion
author: Paul Seidel
work: P-adic splittings of the quantum connection
source_version: Journal de l Ecole polytechnique-Mathematiques13(2026),111-135; DOI10.5802/jep.324; publisher version
difficulty_reason: After the named group-cohomology and quantum-Steenrod prerequisites are supplied, the original local core constructs operations for every p-power level and verifies covariant constancy by comparing incidence contributions. It proves restriction compatibility using a two-stage degeneration of marked pseudo-holomorphic spheres and a finite-gradient-flow separation, then forms compatible p-adic projectors and derives their logarithmic coefficient bound. This complete symplectic and arithmetic inverse-limit construction is substantially beyond ordinary qualification cohomology or p-adic series arguments.
